definition: מַהֲלֻמֿוֺת noun feminine plural strokes, blows (compare Phoenician מהלם stroke, stamp, impression , once on a coin מהלם אגדר coinage of Gader (Gades), = percussura , κόμμα , Ges Mon.pl.40,xiv. c also p. 307 ) — Prov 18:6 (compare Baer ) Prov 19:29 , both times of blows on the body.
